abstract: STUDY DESIGN: A case of unusual dumbbell-shaped cystic teratoma is presented. OBJECTIVES: To investigate and describe an unusual case of retroperitoneal cystic teratoma with spinal invasion in an adult. The image findings, minimally invasive surgical procedures, and clinical outcome were discussed, and the literature was reviewed. SUMMARY OF BACKGROUND DATA: Primary benign cystic teratomas of the retroperitoneum are rare. Extension of these lesions into the spinal canal is more rare. In this report, by presenting a case of cystic teratoma with such extension, the origin of the tumor, and the value of computerized tomography and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) in the preoperative diagnosis and surgical approach for the extended lesion are discussed. METHODS: The patient was a 24-year-old female who had had low back pain with bilateral sciatica for 2 months. Preoperative computerized tomography and MRI of the thoracic and lumbar spines showed a dumbbell-shaped tumor, with the solid part residing in the right retroperitoneum near the neuroforamen of the L2-L3 spines and the cystic part extending into the spinal canal. By performing right L2-L4 hemilaminectomies with a mini retroperitoneal approach, the tumor was removed en bloc in one stage. RESULTS: Diagnosis of cystic teratoma was confirmed by pathologic examination. The patient recovered well without any neurologic deficits, and recurrence of tumor has not been found for 9 years postoperatively. CONCLUSIONS: Total surgical removal of tumor is an ideal treatment for retroperitoneal and intraspinal dumbbell-shaped cystic teratoma. MRI displays the precise location, morphology, and adjacent structures of the tumor, which provide for better preoperative planning and more complete removal of tumor with less neurologic damage.
abstract_ja: 研究デザイン:亜鈴型の稀な嚢胞性奇形腫の症例を提示する。目的:成人の後腹膜および脊柱管内に進展した稀な嚢胞性奇形腫の症例を調べて記述し、画像所見、低侵襲手術、臨床転帰を検討するとともに、文献をレビューする。背景データの要約:後腹膜原発の良性嚢胞性奇形腫は稀である。これらの病変が脊柱管内に進展することはさらに稀である。本報告では、このような進展を伴う嚢胞性奇形腫の症例を提示し、腫瘍の起源、ならびに進展した病変の術前診断と手術アプローチにおけるコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)と磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)の有用性を論じる。方法:患者は2か月間の腰痛と両側坐骨神経痛を訴える24歳女性であった。胸椎および腰椎のCTとMRIで、右後腹膜の神経孔L2-L3付近に充実部、脊柱管内に嚢胞部が進展する亜鈴型腫瘍が認められた。右L2-L4半椎弓切除と小切開後腹膜アプローチにより、一期的に腫瘍を一塊として摘出した。結果:病理学的検査で嚢胞性奇形腫と確定した。患者は神経脱落症状なく良好に回復し、術後9年間にわたり再発は認められなかった。結論:後腹膜および脊柱管内の亜鈴型嚢胞性奇形腫に対しては、腫瘍の全摘出が理想的な治療である。MRIは腫瘍の正確な位置、形態、隣接構造を示し、術前計画の改善と、神経障害を少なくした、より完全な腫瘍摘出に寄与する。
